children: Alphabet Class C (GOOG) fell 12% after earnings, shedding about $550 billion in market value over two sessions. Around 17 firms cut price targets, and Citizens JMP downgraded the stock to Hold.
Alphabet (GOOG) third-quarter Search revenue rose 12% year over year to $63.35 billion, slowing from 19% in Q1 and 17% in Q2. Revenue was nearly flat sequentially; paid clicks grew 8%.
A Hungarian publisher sued Alphabet over claims Gemini reproduced and shared its articles without permission. The court will apply guidance from the EU Court of Justice.
Alphabet (GOOG) is building several Texas data centers. Recent election results may bring tighter construction rules and end tax breaks for the sector.
Alphabet is in preliminary talks with the U.S. Defense Department to provide cybersecurity and data protection for its Golden Dome missile defense initiative; no agreement has been finalized.
Alphabet Inc. Class C (GOOG) launched a $6.7 billion bond offering that received more than $17 billion in orders.
Nancy Pelosi’s 2026 trade disclosures included exercising call options for Alphabet Inc. Class C (GOOG) shares; the transaction date, quantity, and value were not provided.
